name: @mgc/root
description: 「多个音箱，一个大脑」：用一个控制面板统一管理你的全部小爱音箱与 MiGPT 服务

scripts.pub-options: node scripts/nx.mjs run @migptgui/options:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/options
scripts.pub-options-preview: node scripts/nx.mjs run @migptgui/options-with-preview:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/options-with-preview
scripts.pub-gui: node scripts/nx.mjs run @migptgui/gui:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/gui
scripts.pub-controller: node scripts/nx.mjs run @migptgui/controller:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/controller
scripts.pub-server-api: node scripts/nx.mjs run @migptgui/server:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w packages/server
scripts.pub-server: node scripts/nx.mjs run migpt-server:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w apps/server
scripts.pub-cli: node scripts/nx.mjs run migpt-cli:build --verbose && npm publish --access public -w apps/cli
